expectation_adjudications.issue: Manifest hashes pretty oracle JSON; server emits equivalent compact JSON.
expectation_adjudications.resolution: Require identical semantic answer and grade fields, independently hash actual submission and receipt, and verify exact server serialization. Preserve original expected hash.

expectation_adjudications.issue: Manifest called grade(raw) directly; actual bounded reader returns empty bytes before reading a file larger than 65536 bytes.
expectation_adjudications.resolution: Require raw 65537-byte file hash to equal original manifest hash, empty-byte verifier input hash, and every unchanged rejection grade field.

expectation_adjudications.control: original reset and MCP network probe
expectation_adjudications.issue: TCP connect-only success is inconclusive under Harbor transparent proxy.
expectation_adjudications.resolution: Retain all original booleans and source; require 28 additional matching-runtime trials with DNS/HTTP/TLS application checks and allowlisted provider positive control.

limitations: These are trusted stock Harbor oracle/nop controls, not live model rollouts or a measured difficulty result.

The original 28 network probes test only TCP connect to port53 and are inconclusive under Harbor transparent proxy. Original values are retained; 28 additional application-level probes supply the actual finite network checks. These are 98 logical controls plus 28 supplemental trials, not 126 independent logical controls.

Application-layer probes test finite destinations and protocols, not universal egress denial or every proxy bypass. Native Harbor preserves local, configured-DNS and ICMP exceptions; provider HTTPS is intentionally allowlisted.
MCP capability checks do not establish that every stock agent disables its independent built-in tools.
Hash-chained tool logs are evaluator evidence after collection, not tamper-proof against an independently granted same-user shell.
Original control logs and submissions remain evaluator-private; their values must not enter the agent environment.
